verdict.rationale: Appwrite is open-source and self-hostable with full control over data location, and its CLI can list/manage resources and split them into JSON files, giving users significant data portability. However, there is no explicit documented one-click 'export all data' feature or open-format full backup/export tool cited in evidence — missing for 10: a dedicated bulk export/backup command covering all resource types (auth, DB, storage, functions) in a standard open format, and independent confirmation that users have successfully exported and left with all their data intact.
